title: A Smile for the Choir
author: Cyrus Dravenmoor
blurb: Odile Crane, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
